data.body: AC amendment (gap G9): dd-1 closure scope. The DoD wording mentions a throwaway-DIG integration check, but T1's implementation mocks ticket_cli. CLOSURE PROTOCOL: completion-verifier should treat dd-1 as satisfied by (a) the T1 unit test asserting same-pass bug filing via mocked CLI, plus (b) an operator-documented one-time smoke check against throwaway DIG during Phase 0 rollout (not in the test suite). No automated live-Jira test is required for story closure.
